metadata.value: An implementation of the [Clique Percolation Method](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clique_percolation_method) that finds an overlapping clustering of the graph. It does so by merging the k-cliques that share k-1 vertices (k is a parameter of the algorithm). We actually use the plugin `CliqueEnum` to find maximal cliques rather than enumerating all $k$-cliques.
